claims: C1 the document includes default user-level instructions
C2 users can explicitly override such a default instruction
C3 developers can explicitly override such a default instruction

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: the user level of instruction authority: instructions from end users
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the node's NEEDS contract assigns (mechanical licence correction under DECISION_licence_textual.md, 2026-08-16)

concepts.name: default_user_level_instruction
concepts.gloss: an instruction included in the document by default at the user level of authority

concepts.name: explicit_override
concepts.gloss: O is an explicit override of default instruction I
concepts.inference: the clause says users or developers can explicitly override default instructions; an override must relate an override act to the instruction it displaces

concepts.name: developer_authority
concepts.gloss: the developer level of instruction authority: instructions from developers
concepts.inference: the clause names developers alongside users as able to override; the NEEDS node supplies only user_authority, so developer_authority is inferred as the parallel authority level

ontology.gloss: I is a default user-level instruction included in the document

asserts.read_back: overriding default user-level instruction % is permitted when the override is explicit

closure.reason: the clause states that users or developers can explicitly override default instructions; it does not forbid any override, so silence permits
